title: commitron configuration
description: Settings for commitron, which writes commit messages from your staged diff using the Claude Code CLI.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Keeps editor autocomplete working.

model.description: Model passed to `claude --model`. An alias such as sonnet, opus or haiku, or a full model id.

fallbackModel.description: Model to fall back to when the main one is overloaded or unavailable.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the model before giving up.

retries.description: How many times to ask the model to fix a reply that breaks a rule (subject too long, wrong case, missing body...) before showing it. 0 shows the first reply as is.

strictMcpConfig.description: Skip the project's MCP servers. Writing a commit message needs no tools, so this keeps the call fast and cheap.

extraArgs.description: Extra flags appended to the claude command. Escape hatch; you rarely need it.

language.description: Language of the commit description. A code such as en, es or pt, or a full name like "Brazilian Portuguese". The type stays in English either way.

types.description: Commit types the model may use. A reply with any other type is rejected.

scopes.description: Scopes the model may use, like commitlint's scope-enum. Empty means any. A reply with a scope outside the list is rejected; a reply with no scope is fine.

subjectMaxLength.description: Maximum length of the subject line, type and scope included. Going over is a warning, not a failure.

subjectCase.description: Case of the description. lower matches commitlint's subject-case rule, which rejects a sentence-cased subject; names and acronyms such as OAuth or API are still allowed.

scopeCase.description: Case of the scope. lower matches commitlint's scope-case rule. Use any for projects that scope by component name, such as feat(Chip).

body.description: When to add a body. auto adds one only when the change has several distinct parts.

bodyMaxLineLength.description: Body lines are wrapped to this width, matching commitlint's body-max-line-length. 0 turns wrapping off.

maxDiffChars.description: Character budget for the diff sent to the model. Anything past it is cut.

exclude.description: Git pathspecs kept out of the diff. Lockfiles are excluded by default so they cannot eat the whole budget; the files still show up in the file list.

guidelines.description: Your own rules, one per entry, such as "prefix the description with the Jira ticket from the branch name". They go into the prompt above the generic rules.

examples.description: Commit messages from this project the model should imitate, subject and body included.

history.description: How many recent commits of the repository to show the model as style examples. 0 turns it off.

instructions.description: Optional path to a Markdown file with this project's commit conventions, such as an existing CONTRIBUTING.md, relative to the repository root. Its content joins the guidelines above the generic rules.

instructionsMaxChars.description: Character budget for the instructions file.

confirm.description: Ask before committing. Skip it for one run with --yes.

verify.description: Run git hooks. false is the same as git commit --no-verify.

color.description: Colored output. auto turns it off when the output is not a terminal or NO_COLOR is set.

unicode.description: Unicode glyphs and the braille spinner, with an ASCII fallback.
